calibration.reason: The legible, familiar intake supports the task, but misplaced focus after invalid input is a material usability flaw.

primary_action.expected: Select Flood and show its blue backlight on the stage.
primary_action.observed: Flood became checked and focused; the heading and description changed to Flood and Blue backlight. The folded screen became dark blue with illuminated edges and a shadow toward the foreground.

A-1440.edge_observation: ArrowLeft selected Static with visible focus. Its heading and Hard white side light description appeared, and the stage changed to a bright left face with a sharp floor shadow. After Tab moved focus out of the document, the blue selected control and Static heading remained visible.
A-1440.fact_check: The rendered Flood and Static scenes support their short descriptions. The preview is an illustration, so real-world lighting behavior is not verified.
A-1440.strength: The large stage makes the lighting change immediately legible, and selection remains distinct from focus.
A-1440.weakness: The folded screen is an abstract stand-in for a performer, limiting the producer's ability to judge light on a person.
A-1440.repair: Add a clearly scaled performer or an optional human silhouette while preserving the clear lighting contrast.

primary_action.expected: Select Flood and show its blue backlight on the stage.
primary_action.observed: Flood became checked and visibly focused; Flood and Blue backlight appeared beneath a blue stage with a dark foreground shadow.

A-390.edge_observation: ArrowLeft selected Static and changed the scene to a white-lit left face and angular shadow. Tab moved focus out of the document; Static remained identifiable through its filled control and heading.
A-390.fact_check: The visible scene supports the cue descriptions as an illustration; physical accuracy is unverified.
A-390.strength: The stage, all three controls, and the selected cue fit together in the initial mobile viewport.
A-390.weakness: The abstract object conveys the lighting effect but gives little sense of its effect on a performer.
A-390.repair: Offer a performer silhouette or scale reference in the stage preview.

primary_action.expected: Select Flood and show its blue backlight on the stage.
primary_action.observed: Flood became pressed and visibly focused, and the heading and description changed to Flood and Blue backlight. The immediate capture showed a warm, muted stage with a foreground shadow rather than a clearly blue scene.

B-1440.edge_observation: Shift+Tab and Enter selected Static; focus stayed visible on Static. Tab moved focus to Flood while the filled Static button and Static heading still identified the selection. The immediate edge capture showed a predominantly blue backlit scene with an added pale beam from the right, rather than a clearly isolated hard white side light and leftward shadow.
B-1440.fact_check: The accessible descriptions claim blue backlight for Flood and a hard white beam from the right with a long leftward shadow for Static. The immediate captures do not clearly substantiate those color and shadow claims; a transition may have been in progress, so the settled visual state was not verified.
B-1440.strength: The curtain, figure, floor perspective, and dramatic typography create a recognizable theatrical setting.
B-1440.weakness: The immediate stage rendering and cue descriptions are difficult to reconcile during the switch.
B-1440.repair: Ensure each cue reaches an unmistakable visual state promptly and that its beam color and shadow direction match the description; verify the settled and reduced-motion states.

primary_action.expected: Select Flood and show its blue backlight on the stage.
primary_action.observed: Flood became pressed and visibly focused, with the correct heading and description. The immediate stage capture remained warm and muted, with a shadow toward the foreground.

B-390.edge_observation: Shift+Tab and Enter selected Static; Tab then focused Flood while Static remained visibly selected and named. The immediate stage capture was predominantly blue, with a pale side beam, so the described hard white side-light effect was not clearly established.
B-390.fact_check: The text and accessibility descriptions update correctly, but the immediate captures do not clearly support the stated Flood color or Static shadow direction. A transition may have been in progress; the settled visual state was not verified.
B-390.strength: The mobile composition retains the theatrical figure, large cue name, and all three controls in view.
B-390.weakness: The immediate visual cue can conflict with the selected name and description.
B-390.repair: Make the cue change visually decisive and verify the final lighting and shadow after the transition.

preference.reason: A makes both requested lighting states and their selection visibly clear at both widths. B has a more evocative theatrical setting, but its immediate captures do not clearly match the selected cue descriptions, and its settled states were not verified.

decision: The optical bench wins both matched comparisons but a producer needs a human scale reference. Keep round 4 as the best verified draft.
